title: thalictrum flavum subsp. spurium
intro: Thalictrum flavum subsp. spurium, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum flavum subsp. spurium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
